name: adetailer
description_en: Auto detecting, masking and inpainting with detection model.
readme_excerpt: ADetailer ADetailer is an extension for the stable diffusion webui that does automatic masking and inpainting. It is similar to the Detection Detailer. Install You can install it directly from the Extensions tab. Or (from Mikubill/sd-webui-controlnet) 1. Open "Extensions" tab. 2. Open "Install from URL" tab in the tab. 3. Enter https://github.com/Bing-su/adetailer.git to "URL for extension's git repository". 4. Press "Install" button. 5. Wait 5 seconds, and you will see the message "Installed i…
